SELECT channel_code, channel_id, s.store_id, s.store_name, count(*) n, min(sale_date) mn, max(sale_date) mx, sum(net_amount) net
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s USING(store_key)
WHERE s.store_id>=900 OR channel_code<>'ST' OR channel_id IS NULL OR channel_id<>1

SELECT d.fiscal_period, count(*) n, count(DISTINCT sales_line_id) nd, count(DISTINCT (receipt_id,line_no)) nrl, sum(net_amount) net,
 sum(CASE WHEN staff_purchase_flag THEN net_amount END) staff, min(sale_date), max(sale_date),
 count(DISTINCT etl_loaded_at) loads, min(etl_loaded_at), max(etl_loaded_at)

SELECT s.store_id, f.channel_code, f.channel_id, count(*) n, sum(net_amount) net
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s USING(store_key)
WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-08-25' AND DATE '2025-12-21'
  AND (s.store_id>=900 OR coalesce(f.channel_code,'')<>'ST' OR f.channel_id IS NOT NULL)
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2,3

SELECT d.fiscal_period, count(*) n, sum(r.refund_net) refund_net, sum(refund_gross) rg,
 sum(CASE WHEN f.sale_date<>r.return_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) cross_day, count(DISTINCT r.return_line_id) nd
FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s USING(store_key) JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=r.return_date
LEFT JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.sales_line_id=r.sales_line_id
WHERE s.store_id=900 AND d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 5 AND 8
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT d.fiscal_period, sum(net_sales_before_returns) a, sum(returns_net) b, sum(net_sales) c
FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=r.business_date
WHERE r.store_id=900 AND d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 5 AND 8 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT d.fiscal_period, o.status, o.fulfilment_type, count(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) orders, count(*) lines, sum(f.net_amount) net
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s USING(store_key) JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date
LEFT JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
WHERE s.store_id=900 AND d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 5 AND 8
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2,3

SELECT d.fiscal_period, sum(CASE WHEN CAST(f.sale_ts_utc AS DATE)<>f.sale_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) utc_diff, count(*) n,
 sum(CASE WHEN CAST((f.sale_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Helsinki' AS DATE)<>f.sale_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) hel_diff
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s USING(store_key) JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date
WHERE s.store_id=900 AND d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 5 AND 8 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH f AS (SELECT f.sale_date dt, sum(net_amount) n, count(*) c FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s USING(store_key) WHERE s.store_id=900 GROUP BY 1)
SELECT coalesce(f.dt,r.business_date) dt, f.n fact, f.c, r.net_sales_before_returns rpt, r.receipts, r.units_sold
FROM f FULL JOIN (SELECT * FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE store_id=900) r ON r.business_date=f.dt
WHERE coalesce(f.dt,r.business_date) BETWEEN DATE '2025-08-25' AND DATE '2025-12-21'
 AND abs(coalesce(f.n,0)-coalesce(r.net_sales_before_returns,0))>0.01
ORDER BY 1

WITH l AS (SELECT f.receipt_id, count(*) c, sum(gross_amount) g, sum(net_amount) n, min(sale_date) d
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s USING(store_key) WHERE s.store_id=900 GROUP BY 1)
SELECT o.status,
  CASE WHEN l.receipt_id IS NULL THEN 'no lines' WHEN o.order_ts_utc IS NULL THEN 'x' WHEN l.c<>o.line_count THEN 'linecount' WHEN abs(l.g-o.order_total_gross)>0.05 THEN 'total' ELSE 'ok' END chk,
  count(*) n, sum(l.n) net
FROM fact_web_order o FULL JOIN l ON l.receipt_id=o.web_order_id
WHERE coalesce(l.d, CAST(o.order_ts_utc AS DATE)) BETWEEN DATE '2025-08-24' AND DATE '2025-12-22'
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2

SELECT sf.store_id sale_store, rs.store_id ret_store, count(*) n, count(DISTINCT r.return_line_id) nd, count(DISTINCT r.sales_line_id) nsl, sum(refund_net) rn,
 sum(CASE WHEN r.refund_net > f.net_amount+0.01 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) over_refund,
 sum(CASE WHEN r.return_date<f.sale_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) before_sale,
 sum(CASE WHEN f.sales_line_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) orphan
FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store rs USING(store_key)
LEFT JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.sales_line_id=r.sales_line_id
LEFT JOIN dim_store sf ON sf.store_key=f.store_key
WHERE r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-08-25' AND DATE '2025-12-21' AND (rs.store_id=900 OR sf.store_id=900)
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2

SELECT d.fiscal_period, sum(CASE WHEN CAST(r.return_ts_utc AS DATE)<>r.return_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) utcdiff,
 sum(CASE WHEN CAST((r.return_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Helsinki' AS DATE)<>r.return_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) heldiff, count(*) n
FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s USING(store_key) JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=r.return_date
WHERE s.store_id=900 AND d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 5 AND 8 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

calls.statement:
WITH web_sales AS (
  SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, sum(f.net_amount) AS sales_net
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
  WHERE s.store_id = 900 AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 5 AND 8
  GROUP BY 1, 2),
web_returns AS (
  SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, sum(r.refund_net) AS returns_net
  FROM fact_return_line r
  JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.sales_line_id = r.sales_line_id
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = r.return_date
  WHERE s.store_id = 900 AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 5 AND 8
  GROUP BY 1, 2)
SELECT w.fiscal_year, w.fiscal_period, round(w.sales_net - coalesce(r.returns_net, 0), 2) AS net_sales,
  w.sales_net, r.returns_net
FROM web_sales w LEFT JOIN web_returns r USING (fiscal_year, fiscal_period)
ORDER BY 2
